patch_text: TRIGGER: the assessor is about to cite a field of a disclosed extract as sensitive. RULE: a column whose values all show a redaction marker is not disclosed and must not be counted toward severity; rate only the fields actually readable. COUNTER-EXAMPLE: partial masking that still leaves values readable, or other unredacted identifying, credential or network fields, still counts fully, and this rule alone never lowers a level when such fields remain.
risks: Only changes how redacted columns are read; may not move the target if other fields dominate.
